data.name: Appearance_AccentStyleDescription
data.value: Should windows and controls use the Windows system accent color or a fixed theme mode?

data.name: Appearance_ThemeDescription
data.value: Light or dark also updates Windows personalization. System leaves Windows alone and WharfBar follows it.

data.name: Appearance_BackdropModeDescription
data.value: Adjust the blur and transparency effect of the top bar

data.name: DockPage_EmptyHint
data.value: The dock is empty. Drag an app from Explorer straight onto the dock, or add one above.

data.name: DockPage_AutoHideDescription
data.value: Automatically hide the dock at the bottom of the screen when the pointer is not near it

data.name: DockPage_BackgroundDescription
data.value: Mica is real system blur; transparent and tinted recreate the panel

data.name: DockPage_ShowRunningDescription
data.value: Show unpinned running apps and minimized windows in the dock

data.name: TopBarPage_PreviewDescription
data.value: Changes appear here once they are saved to the top bar

data.name: TopBarPage_StatsDescription
data.value: Show CPU, GPU and memory usage next to the Windows logo

data.name: TopBarPage_SplitGpuHint
data.value: When off, all graphics cards are combined into a single value

data.name: TopBarPage_StatusItemsDescription
data.value: Every icon in the catalog is here. Disabled ones stay at the bottom and come back when enabled. Change the order by dragging on the top bar or with the ⋮⋮ handle

data.name: IslandPage_ShowDescription
data.value: Track text you copy and files you drop on the island. If you turn it off, the clipboard listener stops and nothing is recorded.

data.name: IslandPage_MusicVisibilityDescription
data.value: Show while playing: the island keeps the note and track name, and controls open on hover. Show briefly: the island stays idle; controls appear for a short time when the track changes or on play/pause.

data.name: IslandPage_IdleTextDescription
data.value: Clipboard: the pill shows fixed text. Last entry: the pill shows a short preview of the last copied text. While that preview is on screen, the top bar is excluded from screenshots.

data.name: IslandPage_LowBatteryDescription
data.value: 5–50. If the saved value is outside this range it becomes 20; a number typed in the box is clamped to 5–50. When the threshold changes, the next drop is shown once.

data.name: IslandPage_RetentionModeDescription
data.value: Session: kept in memory only and deleted when WharfBar closes. Persistent: written to disk and restored on restart.

data.name: IslandPage_RetentionDaysDescription
data.value: 1–3650. Applies only in persistent mode; in session mode history is deleted on close anyway.

data.name: IslandPage_MaxItemsDescription
data.value: Hard cap of 10–5000. Applies in both modes; the oldest entries beyond it are dropped.

data.name: IslandPage_DeleteDroppedFilesNote
data.value: “Delete dropped files” scans the %AppData%\WharfBar\Drop folder and empties it completely — including orphaned copies that were dropped by MaxItems pruning or cleared earlier. File entries are removed from the list; clipboard texts are untouched. This cannot be undone, so it asks for confirmation.

data.name: IslandPage_ClearHistoryNote
data.value: “Clear all history” empties the list but does not delete the file copies on disk; you need to delete those separately. It also asks for confirmation.

data.name: MonitorsPage_Description
data.value: Choose which monitors show the top bar and dock. Appearance settings are shared across all displays.

data.name: VeilPage_EnableDescription
data.value: Place a semi-transparent color overlay over the screen (dyslexia / visual stress / brightness reduction)

data.name: VeilPage_HotkeyDescription
data.value: Global shortcut to toggle the overlay

data.name: TopBarPage_DisabledHint
data.value: Off — returns to the top bar when enabled

data.name: IslandPage_RangeError
data.value: Enter a whole number in the range {0}.

data.name: IslandPage_DeleteConfirmMessage
data.value:
The %AppData%\WharfBar\Drop folder is scanned and ALL copies in it are permanently deleted.
Your original files are not deleted, but the copies cannot be restored.

data.name: IslandPage_ClearConfirmMessage
data.value:
Clipboard history and dropped-file entries are removed from the list.
File copies on disk are not deleted; you need to remove them separately with “Delete dropped files”.

data.name: About_Description
data.value: A top bar and dock inspired by Windows, macOS and Linux desktops. Fluent / Mica look; a hybrid tray that replaces the taskbar.

data.name: Qs_BluetoothOffHint
data.value: Bluetooth is off — turn it on to see devices

data.name: Brightness_Unsupported
data.value: DDC/CI / WMI brightness control is not supported

data.name: TrayOverflow_NoVisibleIcons
data.value: No tray icons on the taskbar — open Windows' hidden icons (Win+B)

data.name: Island_EmptyHint
data.value: Copied text and dropped files appear here.

data.name: Gallery_Intro
data.value: Built-in items work right away. Local items are a manifest.json record in a folder. A card's slot says where the item will live.

data.name: Gallery_NoBuiltIn
data.value: No built-in items in this view.

data.name: Gallery_SlotsExplanation
data.value: Top bar (topBar), Dock (dock), and Desktop (desktop) are record-only in v1; nothing is drawn on the bar, dock, or desktop. Island (island) runs the Bluetooth notice and camera mirror inside the pill. No code is downloaded from the internet and no assemblies are loaded.

data.name: Gallery_EmptyLocalBody
data.value: Create a folder under the plugins folder and put a manifest.json in it. Files at the root are not read; junction folders are skipped too.

data.name: Gallery_CardBluetoothSummary
data.value: The connected device's name shows briefly in the pill.

data.name: Gallery_CardCameraSummary
data.value: Live preview in the pill. No image without permission.

data.name: Appearance_Logo_Description
data.value: Logo on the top bar and on the dock launch tile

data.name: Island_WallpaperAccent_Description
data.value: After applying a wallpaper from the island, update WharfBar and Windows accent colors from that image.

data.name: Startup_RestrictedLaunch_Message
data.value:
WharfBar was started with restricted permissions (for example from a sandboxed workspace or terminal). Windows does not let it hide the taskbar or reserve the top edge of the screen, so the desktop will not line up with the bar. Settings changes will not be saved in this mode.
Start WharfBar outside the sandbox: copy the built files out of the sandboxed folder (for example to %LOCALAPPDATA%\WharfBar) and run WharfBar.exe there, or start run.bat from a normal terminal.
OK: continue anyway Cancel: quit

data.name: Onboarding_StepWelcome_Subtitle
data.value: A Fluent top bar and dock for Windows. This short setup gets everything ready.

data.name: Onboarding_StepAppearance_Subtitle
data.value: Pick a theme, accent and logo — changes apply immediately.

data.name: Onboarding_StepTopBar_Subtitle
data.value: Choose what lives on the bar. Watch it change behind this window.

data.name: Onboarding_StepDock_Subtitle
data.value: Place the dock and set its size and background.

data.name: Onboarding_StepWallpaper_Subtitle
data.value: Pick a desktop background from the bundled pack.

data.name: Onboarding_StepTour_Subtitle
data.value: The essentials on one page — everything is a click away.

data.name: Onboarding_StepFinish_Subtitle
data.value: A couple of last choices, then WharfBar takes over.

data.name: Onboarding_Welcome_Intro
data.value: WharfBar gives Windows a top bar and a dock: live system stats, quick settings, a clipboard island and a launchpad.

data.name: Onboarding_Welcome_BarBody
data.value: System stats, quick settings, volume, media, notifications and the clock — always one click away.

data.name: Onboarding_Welcome_DockBody
data.value: Pinned and running apps in one strip. Drag to rearrange, right-click for actions.

data.name: Onboarding_Welcome_CustomBody
data.value: Theme, bar items, dock position and wallpaper can all be changed later in Settings.

data.name: Onboarding_Welcome_TaskbarBody
data.value: While WharfBar runs it hides the Windows taskbar and takes over the top edge. Quit from the tray icon (or the logo menu) and the taskbar comes back.

data.name: Onboarding_Welcome_ReplayNote
data.value: Nothing here is final: run this setup again any time from Settings → General.

data.name: Onboarding_Appearance_ThemeHint
data.value: Light or dark also updates Windows personalization; System leaves Windows alone and follows it.

data.name: Onboarding_Appearance_PreviewNote
data.value: The bar and dock behind this window follow every choice you make here.

data.name: Onboarding_TopBar_ItemsHint
data.value: Turn items on or off; the bar updates as you toggle them.

data.name: Onboarding_TopBar_StatsDescription
data.value: Live usage next to the logo. CPU and RAM refresh every second, GPU every four.

data.name: Onboarding_TopBar_GpuDescription
data.value: Shows GPU0 and GPU1 separately on multi-GPU systems.

data.name: Onboarding_TopBar_BackgroundDescription
data.value: Mica blur, fully transparent, or a tinted fill.

data.name: Onboarding_TopBar_BackgroundHint
data.value: Right-click the bar at any time to change its background and opacity.

data.name: Onboarding_Dock_PositionDescription
data.value: Bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right, or a vertical dock on the left edge.

data.name: Onboarding_Dock_SizeDescription
data.value: Icon size; the plate grows with it.

data.name: Onboarding_Dock_BackgroundDescription
data.value: Mica is real system blur; transparent and tinted recreate the panel.

data.name: Onboarding_Dock_Tip
data.value: Drag a file or app onto the dock to pin it. Right-click a tile for Pin, End task, Run as administrator and Windows.

data.name: Onboarding_Dock_RunningNote
data.value: Unpinned running apps and minimized windows appear on the right side.

data.name: Onboarding_Wallpaper_Intro
data.value: Your choice is applied to Windows right away.

data.name: Onboarding_Wallpaper_Empty
data.value: No images yet. Add .jpg, .png or .webp files to the folder, then reopen this step.

data.name: Onboarding_Wallpaper_AccentNote
data.value: Automatic accent color from the wallpaper is paused during setup; turn it on in Settings → Island.

data.name: Onboarding_Tour_Intro
data.value: Three places do most of the work: the top bar, the dock and the Windows key.

data.name: Onboarding_Tour_BarLogo
data.value: Logo menu: Windows settings and power actions, WharfBar Settings, About and Quit.

data.name: Onboarding_Tour_BarIsland
data.value: Island: clipboard, wallpaper, music, shelf and more in a single panel.

data.name: Onboarding_Tour_BarStatus
data.value: Status strip: tray icons, clock, notifications, quick settings, network and battery. Right-click to reorder or change the background.

data.name: Onboarding_Tour_DockPins
data.value: Left: pinned apps. Right: running apps and minimized windows.

data.name: Onboarding_Tour_DockClick
data.value: Click to activate, click again to minimize. Right-click for Pin, End task and Windows.

data.name: Onboarding_Tour_KeysWin
data.value: Tap the Windows key to open the Launchpad with search.

data.name: Onboarding_Tour_KeysChords
data.value: Win+key shortcuts keep working exactly as before.

data.name: Onboarding_Tour_KeysQuit

data.value: Everything is configurable: theme, bar items, dock, island, plugins. This setup can be reopened from Settings → General.

data.name: Onboarding_Finish_Note
data.value: WharfBar is already running behind this window. Finish and the bar and dock are ready to use.

data.name: Onboarding_Finish_SettingsHint
data.value: Everything can be changed later in Settings; quit from the tray icon to bring the Windows taskbar back.

data.name: General_SetupDescription
